done.description: Blocks of this kind and level finished so far, in this world.

kind.description: What the block holds; a line without it (written before the kind existed) is a terrain block.

level.description: Cells per block edge: the terrain level, 4 for an object block, 8 for a tree block.

of.description: Blocks of this kind and level in total, in this world.

phase.description: The run's phase this block belongs to: `terrain`, `objects` or `trees` (an open set).

phase_count.description: How many phases the run has.

phase_done.description: Progress inside the phase; the phase's total never changes during the run.

phase_index.description:
Which phase of the run this is, from 1. A phase is one step of one world, with the reading of the
plugins first and the manifest last.

phase_total.description: The phase's total, in the units of `phase_done`.

run_done.description: Run-wide progress; never decreases during a run.

run_total.description: The run's total, in the units of `run_done`; the same on every line of a run.

up_to_date.description: The block's files were kept from an earlier run (its inputs did not change).

BlockKind.description: What a finished block holds. An open enum: a reader treats a kind it does not know as "other".

oneOf.description: A terrain block (mesh, diffuse and normal map) of a level.
A kind this build does not know, written by a later version. Never written by this build.
